journey.name: Confirm Favorite Story in Saved Bookmarks
journey.description: Verifies that after favoriting an app story (e.g. Xperiencia), switching to the Saved/Bookmarks tab displays the favorited story in the list.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the "Discover" feed
Tap the second tab in the bottom navigation bar to open Saved Bookmarks
Verify that the "Saved Bookmarks" screen is displayed
Verify that the favorited story "Xperiencia" is displayed in the saved list
Tap on the "Xperiencia" card in the saved list
Verify that the story detail screen opens for "Xperiencia"
Verify that the app returns to the "Saved Bookmarks" screen
Tap the first tab in the bottom navigation bar to return to "Discover"
Verify that the app is back on the "Discover" feed
